χθονὸς: χθών — earth, ground; fem. gen. sg.: κατὰ χθονὸς ’down upon the ground’ · also fem. gen. sg. after ἀπό: ’from the earth’ (ἀπὸ χθονὸς ’from the ground’)
ἀΐξας: ἀΐσσω — dart, rush; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’darting’
ἀγγελίης: ἀγγελίη — message, embassy; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ας), after ἕνεκα · also fem. gen. sg., of the business, with ἤλυθες: ’on a message’ (τευ ἀγγελίης ’on some news’) · also fem. gen. sg., object of πεπύσθαι (gen. of what is learned): ’of the news’
ἀγχοῦ: ἀγχοῦ — near, close by; adv. (by-form of ἄγχι)
ἀείραντες: ἀείρω (Attic αἴρω) — raise, lift; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’lifting’
ἀζηχὴς: ἀζηχής — incessant, unceasing; fem. nom. sg.
ἀκούσας: ἀκούω — hear (+ gen. of person/thing heard, + acc. of what is said); aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having heard’
ἀλκὶ: ἀλκή — strength, prowess, defensive might; fem. dat. sg., dat. of what is trusted: ’in strength’
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀλλήλοισι: ἀλλήλων — one another; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι
ἀμέλησε: ἀμελέω — neglect, take no care of (+ gen.); aor. 3 sg. act.: ’neglected’
ἀμυνέμεν: ἀμύνω — ward off, defend; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἀμύνειν)
ἀμφί: ἀμφί — around, about; prep. + acc., with τε following it · also adv. in tmesis with ἕπον: ’around’ (ἀμφί … ἕπον ’dressed’)
ἀμφιγύοισιν: ἀμφίγυος — epithet of spears, perhaps ’double-ended’ or ’strong on both sides’; sense uncertain; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ἀμύμονι: ἀμύμων — blameless (the real sense is not known); masc./fem. dat. sg. (two-ending adj.)
ἀνέμοιο: ἄνεμος — wind; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἀντίλοχ: Ἀντίλοχος — Antilochus, son of Nestor; masc. voc. sg., elided (Ἀντίλοχ’ = Ἀντίλοχε), in address
ἀντίλοχος: Ἀντίλοχος — Antilochus, son of Nestor; masc. nom. sg.
ἀνῆκεν: ἀνίημι — let go, release; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’let go, released’ · also ’urged on, impelled’, with acc. of the person and an infinitive: ’impelled (you) to’
ἀπέβη: ἀποβαίνω — go away, depart; aor. 3 sg., augment inside the compound (ἀπ-έ-βη)

ἀρίστην: ἄριστος — best; superl. of ἀγαθός, fem. acc. sg.: ’the best’
ἀριστερὰ: ἀριστερός — left; neut. acc. pl., used adverbially with ἐπί: ’on the left (hand)’
ἀτὰρ: ἀτάρ — but, and; epic conj. (by-form of αὐτάρ)
ἀχαιούς: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀχιλῆα: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles; masc. acc. sg., epic Ἀχιλῆα (= Attic Ἀχιλλέα)
ἀχιλῆϊ: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles; masc. dat. sg., single-λ epic (= Attic Ἀχιλλεῖ)
ἂν: ἀνά — up, aboard; prep./preverb, with apocope ἂν before δ’; in tmesis (ἂν … βήσομεν ’put aboard’) · also modal particle ἄν (= κεν) written ἂν: with the opt., potential: ’would’; with the subj. after εὖτ’: ’whenever’ · also with ὡς + subj.: ’in the way that’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I may say’) · also modal particle with the subj. after ὅτ’: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂν … γένωνται ’whenever they come to be’) · also modal particle with a fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’could’ (οὐκ ἂν … μυθήσομαι ’I could not tell’) · also εἴ περ ἂν + opt., ’even if … should’ · also εἴ περ ἂν + subj., ’even if … ever’ (εἴ περ ἂν αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’even if they set upon him’) · also εἰ … ἂν + subj., ’if ever, should’ (εἰ δ’ ἂν … ἐθέλωσιν ’but if they should be unwilling’) · also with an indic. past tense, contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἂν … ἦεν ’would have been’) · also modal particle ἄν with the subj. after ὄφρα: ’until, while’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also modal particle ἄν after ἐπεί + subj.: ’once’ (ἐπεὶ ἂν … ἐπίσπῃς ’once you have met’) · also modal particle with the subj. in a general relative clause: ’whomever’ (ὃν … ἂν … νοήσω ’whomever I notice’) · also modal particle ἄν with an infinitive in reported speech, keeping the ’would’ of the direct words: ’he said he would’ (ἂν … ἔφη παραμυθήσασθαι) · also ἂν = ἀνά before ν, prep. + acc.: ’up through’ (ἂν νέκυας ’up through the corpses’) · also with ὡς + subj. in a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν … τιμήσομεν ’so that we may honour’)
ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’ · also ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’lead’ (μή μ’ ἄγε κεῖσ’ ’do not lead me there’)
ἄγριος: ἄγριος — savage, wild; masc. nom. sg., agreeing with χόλος · also Ἄγριος — Agrius, a son of Portheus; masc. nom. sg.
ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.: ’another, anyone else’
ἄλλυδις: ἄλλυδις — in another direction, elsewhere; adv.; ἄλλυδις ἄλλος ’one this way, one that’
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄρηα: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic Ἄρη) · also by metonymy ’war’ (πολύδακρυν Ἄρηα ’tearful war’)
ἅμ: ἅμα (elided ἅμ’) — together with, at the same time, along; adv./prep. + dat.
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνοπῆς: ἐνοπή — cry, shouting, din of battle; fem. gen. sg.
ἐνόησε: νοέω — perceive, notice, think; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’noticed’
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’) · also in ἐξ αὖτις, adverbial: ’again, once more’
ἐξείλετο: ἐξαιρέω — take out; mid. take out for oneself, pick out; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’took out for himself’
ἐοικότες: ἔοικα (perf. with pres. force) — be like, resemble (+ dat.); perf. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’like’
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’) · also adv., ’next, after them’ (τοῖσι δ’ ἐπ’ Ἰδομενεύς ’and after them Idomeneus’) · also + dat. of place, ’close by, hard by’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ τάφρον ὄρυξαν ’dug a ditch close by it’) · also + dat. of time, ’within, in’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a single day’) · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (left) side’ (ἐπ’ ἀριστερόφιν ’on the left’) · also + gen., ’on’ (ἐπ’ εὐνάων ’on anchor-stones’)
ἐπέων: ἔπος — word; neut. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐπῶν): ’of words’
ἐπεσσύμενον: ἐπισεύομαι — rush upon; perf. part. (pres. force) masc. acc. sg.: ’rushing on’
ἐποτρύνοντα: ἐποτρύνω — urge on, stir up; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg., + inf.: ’urging on (to fight)’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’ · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (right) side’ (ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν ’on the right’)
ἐρωή: ἐρωή — respite, pause, abatement; fem. nom. sg.
ἐρύσσομεν: ἐρύω — draw, drag, haul; aor. subj. 1 pl., epic doubled-σ, short vowel, hortatory: ’let us drag’ · also aor. subj. 1 pl., in an indirect question after ὅπως: ’how we may drag’
ἐτύχθη: τεύχω — make, bring about; aor. 3 sg. pass.: ’came to pass’
ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part., epic (= Attic ὄντα); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl.: τά τ’ ἐόντα ’the things that are’
ἐὼν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ὤν)
ἑτάροισιν: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
ἑτάρους: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); masc. acc. pl.
ἑταίρῳ: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. dat. sg.
ἔγχεσιν: ἔγχος — spear; neut. dat. pl.: ’with spears’ (instrumental)
ἔειπες: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 2 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (ἔειπες = εἶπες)
ἔθνος: ἔθνος — company, band, throng; neut. acc. sg.
ἔνθεν: ἔνθεν — from there, thence; adv. of place, correlative of ὅθεν
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔπι: ἐπί — on, upon, over; prep. + dat., placed after its relative with anastrophe (ᾧ ἔπι = ἐφ’ ᾧ ’for which’) · also ἔπι = ἔπεστι, ’is there’, verb with anastrophe (οὐ … ἔπι δέος ’there is no fear’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί placed after its noun, with anastrophe: ’at’ (πηγῇς ἔπι ’at the springs’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’to’ (νῆας ἔπι γλαφυράς ’to the hollow ships’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun: ’to’ (νηυσὶν ἔπι γλαφυρῇσιν ’to the hollow ships’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’over’ (πόντον ἔπι ’over the sea’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί as a preverb in tmesis (ὦρσεν ἔπι = ἐπῶρσεν ’roused against’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, ’for’ (δώρῳ ἔπι μεγάλῳ ’for a great gift’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun: ’at, against’ (Τυδεΐδῃ ἔπι … τόξα τιταίνετο ’drew his bow at Tydeides’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, of place: ’by, along’ (ὁδῷ ἔπι ’by the road’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, of place: ’at’ (νηυσὶν ἔπι γλαφυρῇσιν ’at the hollow ships’, with ὀλέκονται)
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔσσυτο: σεύω — set moving; mid. rush, dash; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic ἔσσυτο (= Attic ἐσύθη): ’rushed out’
ἔσχετο: ἔχω (ἴσχω) — hold; mid. hold before oneself; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’held (before him)’ · also with ὑπό in tmesis (ὑπό … ἔσχετο = ὑπέσχετο): ’promised’
ἔτλη: τλάω — bring oneself to, dare, endure; aor. 3 sg. (ἔτλην, inf. τλῆναι)
ἔτρεσαν: τρέω — tremble, flee in fear; aor. 3 pl. act.: ’trembled’
ἔφαθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἔφατο, elided ἔφαθ’, τ>θ before rough breathing)
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔχει: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. 3 sg. · also intransitive with an adverb, ’be in a state’: εὖ … κομιδὴ ἔχει ’the tending is in good order’
ἔχοντες: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
ἕκτορι: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. dat. sg.: ’for Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg., opponent after μάχομαι: ’with Hector’; and after χωρέω: ’to Hector’
ἕκτωρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἕποντο: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; impf. 3 pl. mid., augmented (ἕποντο = εἵποντο)
ἠΰτε: ἠΰτε — like as, even as; epic particle introducing a comparison
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἠμείβετ: ἀμείβω — exchange; mid. answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἠμείβετ’ = ἠμείβετο)
ἠμὲν: ἠμέν — both (epic correlative, ἠμέν … ἠδέ ’both … and’); conj.
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), correlative with ἠέ · also ’than’ after a comparative (γλυκίων … ἠὲ νέεσθαι ’sweeter than to go home’) · also ’whether’, introducing an indirect question (ἠὲ φυλάσσονται νῆες ’whether the ships are guarded’; ἠὲ κατ’ αἶσαν ἔειπον ’whether I spoke in due measure’)
ἡμεῖς: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; nom. pl.: ’we’
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’ · also ’than, except’ after ἄλλος (ἄλλῳ γ’ ἢ Ἀχιλῆϊ ’than Achilles’) · also in τί ἢ ἐμέ, a form of τίη: ’why’ (τί ἢ ἐμὲ ταῦτα διεξερέεσθε ’why do you ask me these things’) · also ἢ = ἦ, ’truly, surely’ (ἐπεὶ ἢ πολὺ φέρτεροί ’for they are truly far better’)
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form) · also demonstrative, ’she’ (ἣ δ’ … βεβήκει) · also demonstrative in the correlative ἣ μὲν … ἣ δέ: ’one … another’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἣ πληθύς ’the throng’) · also fem. nom. sg. demonstrative, subject of a nominal clause: ’this’
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤθελε: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, want; impf. 3 sg.
ἥρωϊ: ἥρως — hero, warrior; masc. dat. sg., epic -ϊ (= Attic ἥρῳ)
ἰέναι: εἶμι — go; pres. inf.: ’to go’ · also pres. inf. as an imperative: ’go, return’ (ἐλάσας ἰέναι πάλιν ’having driven them off, go back’)
ἰσχάνει: ἰσχάνω — hold back, restrain; pres. 3 sg.
ἰφθίμων: ἴφθιμος — mighty, stout, sturdy; masc. gen. pl.
ἰόντα: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’going, as he goes’
ἱδρῷ: ἱδρώς — sweat; masc. dat. sg., epic ἱδρῷ (= Attic ἱδρῶτι), of means: ’with sweat’
ἱστάμενος: ἵστημι — set, stand; pres. mid. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’standing’
ἲς: ἴς — force, strength, might; fem. nom. sg.
ἴαχε: ἰάχω — cry out, resound, roar; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, of a loud natural noise
ἴδοιτο: ὁράω — see; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., in a conditional clause: ’should see’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., in an indirect question after a verb of looking: ’he might see’
ἴθυσαν: ἰθύω — rush straight on, press forward; aor. 3 pl.: ’pressed forward’
ἴσαν: εἶμι — go, come; impf. 3 pl., epic: ’went’
ἴσχει: ἴσχω — hold, hold back, restrain (intensive of ἔχω); pres. 3 sg.
ἶσον: ἴσος — equal, like; neut. acc. sg.: ’equal’, or adverbial ’equally’ · also masc. acc. sg., + dat.: ’equal (to)’ (ὃν ἶσον ἐτίομεν ’whom we honoured as equal’)
ὀΐομαι: ὀΐω — think, suppose; pres. 1 sg. mid., epic ὀΐομαι: ’I think’ (+ acc. and inf.)
ὀξύτατον: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; superl. ὀξύτατος; neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’sharpest’
ὀπίσσω: ὀπίσσω — behind, backward, afterwards; adv. (= ὀπίσω)
ὀρυμαγδὸς: ὀρυμαγδός — din, uproar, clamour; masc. nom. sg.
ὁμιλαδὸν: ὁμιλαδόν — in a throng, in a crowd; adv.
ὁμοῦ: ὁμοῦ — together, together with, at the same place; adv.
ὄπισθε: ὄπισθε(ν) — behind, at the back; adv.
ὄπισθεν: ὄπισθεν — behind, from behind; adv. · also of time: ’afterwards, hereafter’
ὄρεος: ὄρος — mountain; neut. gen. sg., epic uncontracted ὄρεος (= Attic ὄρους)
ὄρμενον: Ὄρμενος — Ormenus, a Trojan; masc. acc. sg., proper name
ὄσσε: ὄσσε — the two eyes; neut. dual noun, no sg., epic (= Attic ὄμματα)
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρα νέμοιτο ’so that he might enjoy’) · also + fut. indic. in a purpose clause: ’so that … will’ (ὄφρα … εἴσεται ’so that … will know’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’) · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like (demonstrative): ’the’ (ὅ τ’ ἀεργὸς ἀνήρ ’the idle man’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of thinking: ’that, because’ (τὰ φρονέων ὅ μοι … ’thinking on these things, that to me …’) · also εἰς ὅ κε + pres. subj. of duration: ’as long as’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ ἀϋτμὴ … μένῃ ’as long as breath remains’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction: ’in that, because’ (ὅ σφιν ἀμύνω ’in that I ward off from them’)
ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. sg.: ’whom’
ὅπως: ὅπως — so that, in such a way that; conj. + fut. indic. · also ’how’ in an indirect question + fut. indic. (ὅπως ἔσται τάδε ἔργα ’how these things will be’) · also ’how’ in an indirect question + subj. (ὅπως … γένηται ’how … may come about’) · also ’so that’ + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense (ὅπως … διέλθοιεν ’so that they might pass through’) · also temporal, ’when, as soon as’ + aor. indic. (ὅπως ἴδον ’when they saw’)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when, whenever; temporal conj. · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’)
ὅτι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic ὅ τι written ὅτι, neut. nom./acc. sg. · also conj. ’that, because’ (ὅτι τοι κακὰ πολλὰ φυτεύει)
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπ’ Ἀδμήτῳ τέκε ’bore to Admetus’) · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑπ’ ἠελίῳ ’under the sun’) · also + acc. of motion, ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὀστέον ’under the bone’) · also + acc., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ ’beneath the dawn’) · also + dat., of those under whom men fall: ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἀνδράσι … πέσοιεν ’fall beneath men’) · also + gen., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ ’beneath him’) · also ὑπ’ ἐκ + gen., ’out from under’ (ὑπ’ ἐκ κακοῦ ’out from under evil’)
ὑποδύντε: ὑποδύω — go under, get under; aor. part. act. dual masc. nom.: ’the two getting under’
ὑψόθ: ὑψόθι — on high, aloft; adv., elided (ὑψόθ’ = ὑψόθι; = Attic ὑψοῦ)
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’) · also ὡς ὅτε, ’as when’, introducing a simile
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὤριστος: ἄριστος — best, noblest (superlative of ἀγαθός); masc. nom. sg., crasis ὁ ἄριστος (ὤριστος): ’the best’
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing an indirect statement after a verb of remembering: ’how’ (ὥς μ’ … ἔρεξεν ’how he treated me’) · also ὥς = ὡς, ’like, as’, accented after its noun (βόες ὥς ’like cattle’) · also ὥς before the enclitic τοι, in a clause after πείθεο: ’as’ (ὥς τοι … θείω ’as I set for you’) · also ὥς accented before the enclitic τις (ὥς τίς τε λέων ’like some lion’)
ὦκα: ὦκα — quickly, swiftly; adv., from ὠκύς
ὧς: ὥς — thus, so; adv. (printed ὧς, = ὣς; Attic οὕτως)
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
ῥέεθρα: ῥέεθρον — stream, running water, current; neut. acc. pl.
ῥέοντες: ῥέω — flow; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’flowing’
ῥόον: ῥόος — stream, flow; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ῥοῦς): ’stream’
